a
The interior and boundary of the circle of radius 2 centered at (−2,0)
b
The interior and boundary of the circle of radius 1 centered at (0,−2)
c
The interior and boundary of the circle of radius 2 centered at (2,0)
d
The interior and boundary of the circle of radius 1 centered at (0,−2)
e
The interior and boundary of the circle of radius 1 centered at (2,0)
